name: code-mode
description: Claude Code's Code Mode as a mod: one `repl` tool runs JavaScript in a persistent kernel with $, file, edit, write, tools and agent(). Preferred beside the other tools, or the one way to work when the session denies them.

maxCalls.title: Host calls per script
maxCalls.description: A script making more tool/model/agent calls than this is stopped

mode.title: Prompt mode
mode.description: auto: exclusive when Bash, Read and Edit are denied, preferred otherwise; or force preferred / exclusive

subagents.title: Subagents' REPL
subagents.description: shared: a subagent's scripts run in the session's kernel and see its variables; own: each subagent gets a kernel of its own
